nom: La Roche-Posay Serozinc Mattifying Facial Toner Spray

avis.titre: If you are prone to dermatitis, listen up!!!!
avis.texte: I am prone to dermatitis. When I say most products are a miss for me as I have very reactive skin…. I mean it!!! I am prone to barrier issues, struggle with hormonal acne, & perioral dermatitis on top of that. I consistently look for balance in my skincare. This delivered just that!! I use this every other night before serums. My skin instantly feels smooth!! I had a dermatitis breakout and the next morning it was cleared because of this. If you have dry skin this may not be your favorite product. However, if you have oily skin I really do believe you'll love this. I want to add this doesn't give your skin a dull matte look so if you're looking for that, this aint it.
Says it's supposed to target excess shine/oily skin. If anything, my skin was EXTRA oily after using this product

Was using and thought it was calming down my perioral dermatitis, but then the nozzle stopped working and the bottle is still half full. Wish we could execute products in better packaging. Ends up being a complete waste of product, money, and cant recycle! Frustrating.

avis.titre: Not good for acne prone skin
avis.texte: I really wanted to love this product cause it was goving me really smooth skin but after a week of using it, it started giving me really big pimples

This is the holy grail of skin savers for me. There is almost nothing I can put on my face that won't cause a rash or contact dermatitis. I have literally never found a sun screen that doesn't destroy my skin, so I just wear hats. The only face makeup I can wear that consistently causes no problems is the original Benetint, and just about the only moisturizer I can use is Vaseline. Any time I have a reaction to anything, or even a little cluster breakout, I just spray some of this on and it's clearing up within a day. And best of all, I don't have to touch my skin and risk making it worse. I cannot live without this.

avis.titre: Doesn't do anything to do oily skin
avis.texte: I've tried this product out along with the matte daily repair at night & I still wake up oily. Tbh, more than I've ever been. I had such high hopes 😫
I spray this immediately after washing my face. I stopped using for about a month because i ran out, and I felt like I instantly started breaking out!
I LOVE THIS STUFF!!! i spray it on before i put on my makeup and my skin feels amazing and my makeup doesn't stick to dry patches.

This product is a refreshing, easy to use toner spray for oily skin. I like how it mattifies and reduces the appearance of my pores. I also think it helps my skin better receive my morning products. It also lasts a long time because you dont need to apply a lot which makes it cost efficient so one bottle goes a long way.
I'm so happy for this product, makes my face feel refreshing and very smooth and helps with my excess oily skin.
Nice little cool down on days you need it! Lightweight misting spray. Does not smear your makeup or skin products. I highly recommend this product

I really like Serozinc for the simplicity of ingredients, for its light make up setting abilities, and for general shine and pore reduction. It's not a killer setting spray (I use krylon for that) but for my daily natural look with BareMinerals sunscreen tinted moisturizer, I feel like I'm nourishing my skin - and hair- while maintaining a clean look. I even like the salty seaside taste!

I used it for 6 months but there was no difference on my skin. I have tested at least 100 facial products (toners, serums, creams, lotions). Most of the time I have normal skin and the only oily spot is my nose.

Wow, LaRoche Posay has done it again! I just love this company and their products. I have extremely oily skin and I live in Florida..need I say more? This spray keeps my makeup fresh and oil free, although I do have to reapply after lunch but it's actually very refreshing and I find myself looking forward to my afternoon spray! 10/10 would recommend
Loved this product! Had my face feeling so clean and light! Good value. Packaging was nice and simple, which kept it from being too distracting.
I use this in the Morning and also to set my makeup because it's so good. Keeps my face matte and set perfectly and also on a regular daily basis just keeps my face fresh & not shiny.

I got the La Roche Posay Serozincist as soon as my dermatologist recommended it to me. It promises to control the oiliness and shrink enlarged pores. Being zinc the star ingredient here, I knew it would be good a good product for me. In terms of controlling the oiliness, it did a pretty decent job but there's no miracle. I feel it kinda withheld the shine for a while but it had to be reapplied during the day. I didn't see much difference on my pores, to be honest. But the best use for this mist I found to be after having my make-up done. Just a generous spray on my face and it would keep a mattified look for longer (I didn't need to reapply layers of powder to get rid of the shine) and make my foundation and concealer last way longer than without it. It was a great product to have at hand during hot days.
I definitely love this product! It helps to control my oil excess and at the same time helps to keep it moisturizer. Never stay without it, I already bought it several time. For me is perfect.
It's very good, odorless, and refreshing. It also helps with the the greasy areas of my face without drying it. I use it every day after showering my face
Great and refreshing must spray. I use it after I shower and dry off, prior to applying eye/face cream!
Absolutely in love love the way it comes the skin I use it for a prep befor putting my makeup on and it works perfect

avis.titre: Naomi Campbell made me do it
avis.texte: Need I say more, ok that woman is 50+ ok and stunning and I aspire to look that good in my 50s. light weight mist and it's refreshing if put in the fridge . No smell, and does wonders to keep my skin clear. I've been known to use it on more than just my face.

I really like this product, I have mature normal to dry skin and I love how it makes my skin feel. I use Serozinc Face Mist after I wash my face, It seems to leave me with skin that's smooth and firm.

I really like this product. I was never good about using toner because you have to use a cotton ball and you have to wipe your face a certain way, using an upward motion so that you sweep away all impurities, so much work! This you just spray on your face and you're done. While using this with my moisturizer I have seen an amazing improvement in my skin.

The I have large pores, but after using this Mist, my pores are noticeably smaller. I watched a YouTube video of Naomi Campbell, and she recommends using a Zinc Mist as part of your skin care routine.

avis.titre: La Roche Posay Serozinc Face Mist
avis.texte: I love using this in the morning right after cleansing to balance and calm my skin before applying moisturizer. This toner sits well under makeup which is a huge plus for me. I have dry skin so when I bought this product, I was worried that it would be too drying for me considering it says "Mattifying", however, I find it to be just right and not too drying.

I enjoy using the La Roche-Posay spray after cleansing my face. It helps with shine reduction throughout the day and it is weightless on the skin. I also love the easy application. Just spray and you're done! I would recommend to those with oily skin.

This face mist is nice to have around if you have oily skin. The bottle sprays a super fine mist that feels really refreshing on the skin. If your skin is feeling a bit oily throughout the day, it will mattify it. It doesn't work as well if you let your skin get too oily. I also think it didn't do anything when it came to preventing my skin from becoming oily.
I have very oily skin. It seems nothing works but I like this product. It did help reduce my oily face. I will purchase this product, especially for the summer. The price isn't bad either.

I got this facial mist in a voxbox and it's overall a good product but I can't say I'd buy it again. It claims to help with shine control but I've noticed next to no difference. I will say that I do enjoy the actual sprayer itself as it produces a really lovely fine mist that doesn't cause immediate huge droplets on your face.

There was not a bunch of extra ingredients in the product, which is a plus. Just water, zinc sulfate, and sodium chloride. I used this twice a day for a couple weeks and did not notice any difference in size of my pores. It did a nice job of reducing shine though.

After using the water mist every morning for 3 weeks. I can say for myself that it helps my skin feel hydrated throughout the day. It also gave me a fresh boost every morning to tackle the day. I would recommend this product to others as well.

The La Roche Posay is a brand I've only recently began to explore. I was ordering some body lotion & came across this Serozinc Face Mist, I chose to 'add to cart' and I'm so glad I did. It really helps tame my afternoon oily t zone. There's a noticeable difference the days I forget to use it. The product is 3 simple ingredients, water, zinc and sodium chloride aka salt - the water used by this brand is reported to be magic - zinc helps skin heal. All ingredients are found in nature- I love that there are no chemicals in this product.
this toner is amazing, it helps my pores look less visible. the spray nozzle is nice, the spray comes out in a nice even midst. I definitely would buy this.

I like the most of this cleanser, it is super refreshing to the face once applied and it doesn't feel sticky at all, leaves a smooth finish even if you don't moisturize!! Will definitely recommend, I received this product complementary for testing by @influenster and I love it ❤️

I don't use many facial mists so I wasn't sure about this one, but I'm so glad I gave it a try! The spray is lightweight and doesn't feel heavy or sticky on the skin. I've been getting compliments on my skin so I'll take that to mean this is working! It's a nice addition to my current skin care routine.

I have really been enjoying using this product. I actually do think it helps keep my natural face oils at bay throughout the day. I love the spray nozzle too- it's refreshing and not too aggressive. I also appreciate that the product is unscented and doesn't leave any sort of residue on my face after using.

I was really excited to try this product and especially this brand! Let's start off with a few positives! The first is that the mister on this is amazing and produces a really fine mist. The product also has no scent which is perfect for sensitive skin. The product also leaves your face refreshed without a sticky feeling. Now let's talk about the negatives. This product did absolutely nothing for my skin. I used it for two weeks daily as recommended on the packaging. It reminds me of the Evian mist in that it's literally just water meant for 5 minutes of feeling refreshed. I was disappointed because this product is not cheap and I would expect to do more for my skin. I noticed no long term or even short term benefits of using this product.

I have never used a product like this before but I love it and use it pretty much every day now. I spray it on my face as soon as I get out of the shower. The mist is nice and fine and it dries down quickly. This product really helps my makeup stay in place all day!
I love that the mist is fine and leaves zero residue unlike other sprays. My skin felt fresh and clean after using it. I would recommend this to anyone that wants to up their beauty routine.

I use this after washing my face every morning and every night. After washing, my face is normally very dry and tight feeling. Using this adds moisture and loosens up my skin a bit. The mist feels amazing and has a great cooling effect. It also dries quickly and isn't sticky or oily. It also doesn't have a scent which I like. I received this product free for testing purposes.

I do not use primer and my make up routine so I used this product then immediately put on foundation. Overall it definitely made my skin feel tight and look smooth with make up on. I'd recommend trying it! ￼￼

I like this spray toner quite a lot! It sprays very evenly and dries quickly on my face, and it's good for a little pick me up after I've taken off my makeup but not fully washed my face, for example. I don't notice a scent, but it may have a slight one, sort of fresh? But having toner in a spray form is so much nicer than having to find a cotton ball and do it that way. I'm a fan! I do not know the cost of this item, since it was sent to me for free in a vox box in exchange for an honest review.
Love this product ! It's really easy to use it and it get ab sorbed really quick by the skin.I have an oily skin and it works awesome on my face! looking less greasy and more matte

If I could rate as 4.5 I would, but being that I'm on the app, I cannot so c'est la vie. Anyhow, I'm usually skeptical of anything claiming to tame oil as I'm an oily-completed gal, but this is actually on point! If outside opens up again, I'd love to test this out and see if it still keeps the excess oil at bay during the Summer! So far, I use twice a day or actually just once because the oil production is so noticeably less pronounced upon my morning application. I only didn't give it 5 stars because my nozzle sticks and it doesn't spray evenly all the time, but other than that, this does what it says it's going to do and I'm happy.

This is my first time trying a mattifying spray, at first I was a bit skeptical about a spray that can mattyify your face and have no oils shining thru and as an oily person on my t zone I was really interested to try this so after a first couple of uses I can say that it is good at keeping your makeup set and not having as much oils coming thru, this worked only for a couple of hours.

I was excited to try this product. However I was disappointed with the results. This is essentially water in a spray can. I'm aware that you are supposed to immediately use moisturiser after you wash your face while your face is still damp. I used this product to quickly spritz my face before I applied moisturiser. I do not recommend La Roche Posay Serozinc Face Mist it's too expensive for what you get and doesn't do anything.

Love how it is in the mist form so don't have to worry about using cotton pads! Just spray it and you're done. Talking about the quality of the product, its 10/10 as it smoothens your skin, lesser pores. I use it in my night time skin care routine and it has worked wonders. Sometimes i also use it before the cream, while doing make up. It works great that way too. I would definitely recommend it to try.

avis.titre: La Roche Posay Serozinc Face Mist
avis.texte: This mist is fragrance free which is nice especially if you prefer skincare without fragrance. The continuous mist sprays quite nicely, leaving a even coating on the face and dries quite quickly. I used this for a few days and really wanted to enjoy it however, I feel, that this product isn't made to be used in the winter, at least for my skin. I found it to be too drying for me as I need something more moisturizing. I would definitely give it another shot when warmer weather rolls around. This could definitely be a good summer product when my skin is more oily in the summer.

I think the product is easy to apply and feels great on the skin. However, I am not sure that it's effective in reducing oil. I actually broke out a little in my first week using it. I think that with more time this product might be more useful

I filled out the questionnaire. I dont have an oily skin so I dont know how to review this product. I did spray it on my face and I dont know what to expect. Why was I sent this product? What's the point of filling out the questionnaire?

I really enjoy facial mists and like to spray them on when I get out of the shower when my face is still damp to maintain moisture. This one has a nice most and helps with not being super oily at the end of the day. Would definitely buy again!

I got this thinking I would use it more than I actually do. I always forget to put it on before any kind of moisturizer and when I do use it... I just don't know what it's supposed to do. I know its supposed to reduce pores but I haven't seen any difference in my skin. I think its just a really nice can of refreshing mist.
I am sensitive and oily skin at the same time and I can say that this product helped me to reduce the oiliness of my skin a little, leaving it fresh and radiant and I really love it

I have very oily skin, so I was very skeptical of using a new face product. After only a few days I am in LOVE. It makes my face soft without making it oily or greasy. I would definitely recommend this to others.

I love this spray!! It's so refreshing to spray on my face after I wash it. But- has it made a difference in my skin or helped reduce the size of my pores? Hard to say. All I know is that it feels great on my face!
i wasn't blown away by this product which is why i only gave it three stars. i do think it helped with oil but not to the point where i would go out of my way to buy it.

I gave fewer stars because I don't love that it's an aerosol type of spray, however it did make a difference in my skin. My skin feels very smooth and soft after using and it's been a great pre make up addition the last few weeks.

This toner is amazing! It doesn't have a strong fragrance such as most products, which i am very happy about! It's a lot like a refreshing water mist. It leaves skin feeling smooth and glowy! I love it! Glad i got to try this out!

It claims it mattifies skin, soothes and helps with large pores. I have been using for a few days now and see a difference in my pores. I don't feel it mattes my skin but I also have oily skin type. Feels nice on skin not drying at all.
I've never used a toner before, but that will change now! I love how my skin felt and it was a great base for my moisturizer and foundation.

This product really surprised me. It definitely helps fight back the oil. Not harsh on the face at all. Feels lightweight on the skin and absorbs quickly. The mist is awesome, covers a lot of your face at once. This way you don't have to waste product either. This toner will be apart of my skincare routine from now on. I recommend LA ROCHE-POSAY Serozinc spray for anybody who has oily skin issues. Promise you'll like it.

I tend to rush when getting ready. working and caring for 2 kids doesn't leave me with a lot of time. I LOVE this spray. I've never tried a spray face care product before and wow. Quick, easy addition to my skin care routine. My skin feels soft and smooth after using it, with no heavy or greasy feeling. this product doesn't have much of a smell but thats not a big deal- its neutral smelling which is just fine.

I received this complementary from Influenster! I like the concept of the product, but I don't totally love the product itself. It was quick and easy to use with a few quick spritzes. I also didn't detect any fragrance. It didn't irritate my skin or break me out which is a huge plus and oddly enough I do feel as if I saw my pore size reduce a little. This did dry my skin out which I was not a fan of. It honestly felt like I was just spraying water on my face. I also forget to use it because it's not something I think of when I do my skincare routine. I think it's a good product and would work for someone who is super oily skinned since I am have more combination skin.

I received this mist for free to review it and this is my honest review. This mist is really really fine, its for oily skin and it helps you minimize your pores. unfortunately I couldn't use it these days because my face is super dry in winter :( but I am excited to use it as the summer time approaches. it visibly minimizes your pores all my girls with oily skin will fall in love with it!!!! I definitely recommend it

I already had another toner that I have used for many years and love but this was decent compared to that one. The packaging is pretty but I wish that it wasn't in a spray form cause that made it difficult to use. I can't say much about how it controls oil cause while I do have oily skin it's not as much of a nuisance in winter and I am a lot less shiny as opposed to summer. It did make a noticeable difference with my pores though as they looked a lot smaller throughout the day. Overall I like it for what it is I just wish it was in a more convenient vehicle for easier use.
i really like this product. it made my skin feel so smooth and I absolutely love the fact that its a spray bottle.. i would absolutely recommend this and will definitely be using it again.

This product is really nice and a great addition to my skin care routine. It's a nice, big spray with a fine mist. It claims to shrink pores and eliminate oiliness. Since adding a retinol to my skin care routine, I am not as oily so I cannot attest to that. However, I do have very large pores on my nose and they are visibly smaller after a few uses. I am very surprised and so happy with this. My skin looks smoother!

Y'all I swear by this spray!!! My face gets sooo oily throughout the day It's horrible !!!! I spray this LA ROCHE-POSAY ( SEROZINC) spry right after the shower and it helps all day long NO OILINESS at all !!!!! It's also helping reduce my pores!!! I was so impressed the first day I used it!!! Trust me you will not regret your purchase!!!

I have fairly oily skin, especially with having to wear masks all the time now. Within one use my face didn't look as oily and pores looked smaller! Packaging looks as if would be super expensive, but it's fairly affordable.

avis.titre: Great spray with zinc for oily skin
avis.texte: After using this #laroche-posay spray my skin appears less oily. I used it right after washing my face. It's very gentle mist.
This is the first time I have tried this product and I love it. It makes my skin smooth. It is now one of my favorite products. It is effective and I would give it a 10/10.
The box is beautifully packaged. I will be using it as well as my sisters and mother.

This is my favorite toner ever! I love the light mist application and that it leaves my skin feeling hydrated and refreshed. It dried quickly but didn't dry out my face. I also love how big the bottle is - I feel like I got my money's worth!
This is a nice and refreshing mist. Use it after washing your face and before moisturizer.

avis.titre: Amazing - I've already recommended to all my frien
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin and a lot of products irritate or cause a burning sensation, but this product is super soothing. I can also tell a difference in my skin. It doesn't feel oily, it's smooth. Will definitely being using this in my everyday routine!

La Rocheposay dont have a smell.. I used it on my oldest son... it helps his face feel smooth... I noticed he's not getting as much pimples on his face.. ill keep trying this and see if it keeps helping him..

I've recently had very dry skin. I used this after washing my face but before moisturizer and it seems to help my moisturizer sink into my skin better. I didn't really notice a difference oil wise but it did help my skin stay moisturized.

Lately because of how irritated my skin can get; I now only use Dr. Barbara Sturm skincare and her supplements to help skin from the inside out and after I started using it and now after a few months; wow realized this brand is for real and my skin has never felt better so I haven't used any other brands other than hers but when I saw this and saw the ingredients which are excellent I gave it a try and I will definitely be repurchasing for me it helps some of my skincare sink in a bit more I have found which is awesome for the days I need my skin cream to sink in fast so I can wear makeup on the days I work. This is a BEAUTIFUL SPRAY! The nozzle is better than the Evian one and it's ingredients are better as well. I have the most iriitated skin in the world most skin mists I try just make my skin red and also flaky because I have such dry skin but this la roch posay spray is amazing the fine mist it give your face is like a magical dream it helps wake you up in the morning as well with a quick spritz I think the can will last me a long time . Best item I've gotten from Influenster's where I received this item for free for reviewing purposes. And I will definitely be repurchasing even my sister loved it!

How can something so simple be so effective? I spray this as part of my AM routine after a shower to help hydrate and it makes me feel so fresh and ready for the day. I then use eye cream, serums, water gel, spf....foundation.

I've only used this product a few times, and I already see a difference! La Roche-Posay is a great brand that I would definitely recommend, and this product does not fail expectations. I got the Serozinc mist, and my skins feels smoother and way less oily. It was great!

I really enjoy using this toner in some ways. The mist is perfect. It feels like the mister on a sunscreen bottle, so one can get great coverage. However, while the mist is nice and light, it does get in my hair and on my shoulders. It is so light that it is easy to spread coverage too far.

first off let me start by saying I love the way the spray mist comes out it has a wide coverage area and its very gentle and light. as soon as it touches your face it is so cooling, refreshing and soothing . I used it after washing my face but before my moisturizer. I did notice a wonderful difference from the slight shine I usually have so I am glad I got to try a new product and I will have a new addition to my beauty routine!!

This toner is pretty nice. I do not just spray it on my face though, as I have found out that it sprays waaaaay too much. I spray some in my hands and then pat in on. It does do a good job of mattifying my face, but I haven't seen any visible reduction in my pore size. All in all it's not bad, but I wouldn't purchase it.

I was more than excited to see this brand in my box! This leaves your skin looking so effortlessly flawless and just smooth and perfect. 10 out of 10 suggest this brand, if you were thinking about buying it go for it￼

So I got this today in my box. I just tried it and I could instantly feel the oil disappearing on my face.￼ like I said I just got it so I don't know the full effects of it. I'll keep you updated!La Roche Posay Serozinc Face Mist ￼

A nice soothing mist I really enjoy this toner as a final step before my moisturizer, but I do not think it works well as a toner to use before applying serums. The directions say to pat off the excess after letting it sit for a few minutes, but by that time it's mostly dry and will not aid in serum absorption. Using this as a final step before moisturizer works slightly better, but I have not noticed considerable oil reduction. Overall, I wouldn't buy it for its oil reducing properties, but it is nice for my sensitive skin and has a very nice fine spray.
best product in the world for oily skin !!! as I love it, I feel my skin safe and dry all day, you can use it as a make upLa Roche Posay Serozinc 150Ml Toner Gor Oily Skin Zinc Sulfate Solution
I think it's worked best as a makeup setting spray, not as a toner which was my intention when I purchased it.

Favorite toner. Helps with oil production and breakouts. I use it a lot when I have breakouts. You can also soak a cotton pad and press it onto skin with breakouts to use as a spot treatment. Helps with oil production to balance skin. Very fine mist as well. This is my 3rd can of this. A little goes a long way. Ingredients are also very simple. Great for people with sensitive skin or with breakouts. La Roche Posay Serozinc

avis.titre: Gently Cleanses Skin, good for sensitive skin
avis.texte: My skin was quite rough at the beginning, after I used it, my skin became softer

That product is awesome for my sensitive skin, my dermatologist told me about it and also to use 2x a day after clean my face, let it dry and then add my moisturizer or anytime that I need to refresh and calm the irritations. It works good on my scalp too. I cannot live without it! La Roche Posay Serozinc

Can't recommend this enough. I use it at nighttime after my skin routine and in the morning to set my makeup. Adds a natural sheen to give glow and keeps makeup in place. Also helps keep my skin clear. Would buy over and over again!
Helps calm my oily skin before putting on makeup. It's nice spray it doesn't come all at you.
Ever since I started using it my face appears to be less shiny.

Great for everyday use. As a toner, as a makeup setting spray. Hydrated, refreshing, cooling. For oily, aging, sensitive and problem combo skin as well. Helps with inflammation of breakouts and reducing redness.

Helps control my sebum but not the best at hydrating. I use oil blotted paper and spray this on my skin afterwards. It really makes me feel refreshing and skin stay matte. A must for Summer and even Winter.

I love this product. I actually improved my skin markedly and literally overnight. The only thing is that the bottle is enormous, which makes it difficult for traveling. They make a smaller size that's available in Europe. I wish it were available here. Or I wonder if it would affect the product to spray it into a smaller pump spray bottle?

I use this to sandwich my hyaluronic acid serum, and it works great. Routine: cleanse, light serozinc mist, hyaluronic acid serum, light serozinc mist, moisturize. Plumps up the skin full of hydration, and then the moisturizer traps it in!

I discovered this product thanks to my sister and I have to thank her! I have substitutes my daily toner for this. The application just feels awesome and fresh but it also does work wonders on controlling pores and shine! I have officially become a fan and will keep buying it!

avis.titre: I can't tell for certain if this does anything
avis.texte: I don't wish to be uncharitable in my review of this. In my use of the Serozinc face mist, I have always applied it per the instructions after I cleansed my face, then applied moisturizer later after the Serozinc dried. That said, using it day after day for a week has made no noticeable difference in how soon my skin appears as oily as it does. Thus, especially for the price, I can't say I recommend this. I am sure it works for some people, but it didn't for me.
Great product! I have oily skin and this helps reduce oiliness and creates a more matte complexion for me. It soothes, cools, and tones down redness as well. I will never use another toner again.

I love to use this during hot summer day or when I am on tropical vacation, it hydrates your skin and helps you reduce the oil on your face! I use big bottle at home and I also have travel size that I can just throw in my purse!

I have used an entire can so far. Not sure it did anything for me but maybe it helped reduce breakouts. Not that cheap either. Refreshing spray though. Not sure it helped in reducing my visible pores like it states it does. Don't think I will buy this again.

For years I have been trying to find products that work on my skin. I have very oily skin and look older than I am. Even using "anti-aging" didn't help with the "looking older" and only made my skin more oily. Approximately, two months ago I found and purchased this moisturizer (and some other products from La Roche-Posay) and can not believe the difference in two months! I could actually wipe the oil off my face every hour before and now maybe once or twice a day I do it. Each day my skin is better than the day before. Breakouts are happening less and fine lines are smoothing away. I also love how refreshing this feels after applying it! I can not wait to see how much better it will get in the coming months.

I've been using this toner for a couple of months, and it has definitely helped with my oiliness and it's super soothing. I still get pretty oily throughout the day, so I'm on the hunt for a good targeted serum.

This is one of my favorite mists and I've repurchased it many times! The nozzle can be wonky sometimes, but I use this mist as part of my skincare routine so I don't mind if it sprays too much. It always absorbs straight into my skin and is especially good for cooling during the summer.

First off the spray comes out so amazing; it is fine and evenly applies to your skin. It really helps to soothe any irritation and inflamed skin. It also keeps my skin balanced since I have combo oily skin that is acne prone. I learned that since it helps with inflamed skin, it is super helpful if you get a bug bite because it helps to reduce the redness and itchy skin. Finally it is really soothing if you get too much sun and have a sunburn. Can't say enough good things about this product.
Even if it is for oily skin, it gives you moisturized feeling after all. It's also very soothing. I'm going to buy a second bottle!
